steps.title: Draw Phase
text: The turn player draws 1 card from their Deck.
This is the first phase of every turn. You must draw 1 card from the top of your Deck.
If you cannot draw because your Deck is empty, you lose the Duel.
**The player who goes first does draw during their first Draw Phase**, giving them a 6-card hand after drawing.
After drawing, Trap Cards or Quick-Play Spell Cards can be activated before proceeding to the Standby Phase.

steps.title: Draw Phase
text: The turn player draws 1 card from their Deck.
This is the first phase of every turn. You must draw 1 card from the top of your Deck.
If you cannot draw because your Deck is empty, you lose the Duel.
**The player who goes first does NOT draw during their first Draw Phase** — they start their first turn with only their initial 5-card hand.
After drawing, Trap Cards or Quick-Play Spell Cards can be activated before proceeding to the Standby Phase.

steps.title: Standby Phase
text: Resolve effects that activate during the Standby Phase.
If a card says to do something during the Standby Phase, resolve those effects now. This includes maintenance costs that must be paid.
Trap Cards and Quick-Play Spell Cards can be activated in this phase.

steps.title: Main Phase 1
text: Play cards and set up your field before battling.

steps.title: Once per turn
bullets: **Normal Summon** a monster in face-up Attack Position
**Set** a monster in face-down Defense Position
Levels 1–4 require no Tributes
Levels 5–6 require 1 Tribute
Levels 7+ require 2 Tributes

steps.title: As many times as you want
bullets: **Special Summon** monsters (Fusion, Ritual, or by card effects)
**Flip Summon** a face-down monster to face-up Attack Position
**Change battle position** of monsters (once each, except: cannot change a monster played this turn)
**Activate** Spell Cards and Trap Cards, or card effects
**Set** Spell and Trap Cards face-down

steps.title: Battle Phase
text: Declare attacks with your monsters and deal battle damage.
The Battle Phase is divided into 4 steps. The player going first cannot conduct a Battle Phase on their first turn.

steps.title: Start Step
text: Announce you are entering the Battle Phase.

steps.title: Battle Step
text: Select 1 Attack Position monster to attack with and 1 target. Each Attack Position monster can declare 1 attack per turn. If your opponent controls no monsters, you may attack directly.

steps.title: Damage Step
text: Calculate battle damage. Only Counter Traps and ATK/DEF-modifying effects may be activated here, and only before damage calculation.
bullets: **vs Attack Position** (ATK vs ATK): Higher ATK wins, difference is battle damage. Equal = both destroyed, no damage.
**vs Defense Position** (ATK vs DEF): ATK > DEF = destroy defender, no damage. ATK ≤ DEF = neither destroyed, difference dealt to attacker as damage.
**Direct Attack:** Full ATK as battle damage.

steps.title: Replay
text: If the attack target leaves the field before the Damage Step, you may re-select a target or cancel the attack.

steps.title: End Step
text: Announce the end of your Battle Phase.

steps.title: Main Phase 2
text: A second chance to play cards after battling.
After the Battle Phase, you may enter Main Phase 2. You can perform all the same actions as Main Phase 1, but limited actions already used (Normal Summon/Set) cannot be repeated.
If you did not conduct a Battle Phase, Main Phase 2 is skipped.

steps.title: End Phase
text: Conclude your turn and discard to 6 cards if needed.
Announce the end of your turn. Resolve any card effects that activate during the End Phase.
If you have more than 6 cards in your hand, discard to the Graveyard until you have exactly 6.
